references.text: Joshua received Timnath-Serah in the hill country of Ephraim as his inheritance, and he rebuilt the city and settled there.
Joshua was buried in his inheritance in Timnath-Heres in the hill country of Ephraim, north of Mount Gaash. This is a parallel account of Joshua's burial.
Joshua son of Nun was one of the spies sent out from the tribe of Ephraim, and this verse mentions his origin.
Joshua son of Nun is referred to as Moses' servant, which highlights his role before he became leader and was buried in his inheritance.
Joshua son of Nun was filled with the spirit of wisdom because Moses had laid hands on him. This shows his selection as leader before his death and burial.
